description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Do you have a proven track record in planning and executing successful sales strategies within the energy and/or engineering industry? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a background in technical sales and passion for technology, innovation, and sustainability?

At DEIF, we are looking for a Sales Manager, Marine & Offshore, to strengthen our Brazilian sales team and drive regional growth.

DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We want to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.

About the Job

The Sales Manager, Marine & Offshore, will be an instrumental part of our strategic sales plans. You will be conducting technical and commercial visits to clients, with the goal of identifying business opportunities.

Your consultative approach to clients will focus on understanding their needs and propose solutions to enhance DEIF's products and services for energy management.

It is crucial to have strong account management and negotiation skills, a willingness to continually learn and adapt, and knowledge of the marine & offshore market.

Working tasks & responsibilities

  • Developing new customers targeted by the company by introducing products, conducting demos/trials for approvals, and securing contracts/orders.
  • Aligning individual (quarterly and annual) goals and contributions with the department goals, as well as the overall sales/growth strategy.
  • Managing and visiting existing customers, including OEM’s, marine electrical systems integrators, engine dealers, asset owners, and switchboard manufacturers.
  • Preparing technical and commercial proposals, ensuring they meet specific client needs.
  • Actively selling to new and existing customers all ranges of DEIF products.
  • Participating in marine related exhibitions and trade shows.
  • Following price management processes and entering relevant leads/visits in CRM.
  • Focusing on process improvements and team collaboration with the operations, service & support teams.
  • Understanding safety measures in line with our Global Safety Policy. Identifying gaps and proactively suggest improvements.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of successful experience in technical sales, preferably in the marine and offshore sector with generators, technology, or industrial controls, protection relays, PLCs, instrumentation, power conversion & power management.
  • Experience with end-to-end sales cycle, from lead generation to closing.
  • A hunter mentality, with high resilience and proactive approach.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build solid, long-lasting relationships.
  • Knowledge of local marine market and customers.
  • Ability to travel as needed.
  • Knowledge of applications and products.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English – Verbal, written and presentation skills.
  • Experience working with CRM systems.
  • Team player with a growth mindset.

Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.

At DEIF, we are Winning Together!

We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration are essential.

We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized as the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.

 Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência: Mais de 5 anos atuando como desenvolvedor(a) fullstack, com histórico comprovado de participação em projetos complexos e escaláveis.

  • Performance: Otimização de Web Vitals, análise de bundles, ajuste de queries em banco de dados e profiling de memória.

  • Integração de Sistemas: Experiência com integração de APIs de terceiros, brokers de mensagens, webhooks e sistemas distribuídos.
Engenharia de Software Avançada

  • Padrões Arquiteturais: Clean Architecture, Arquitetura Hexagonal, Onion Architecture e domínio dos princípios SOLID.

  • Estratégias de Testes: Aplicação da pirâmide de testes, práticas de TDD/BDD, mutation testing e contract testing.
  • Revisão de Código: Revisões de código e boas práticas.
️ Frontend com React
  • Domínio do React 18+: Server Components, funcionalidades concorrentes (Concurrent Features), Suspense, Portals e tratamento de erros (Error Boundaries).
  • Performance: Otimizações com React.memo, useMemo, useCallback, lazy loading e code splitting.
  • Padrões Avançados: Componentes compostos, render props, hooks personalizados e higher-order components.
  • SSR/SSG com Next.js 14+: Uso de App Router, streaming e incremental static regeneration (ISR).
  • Gerenciamento de Estado: Redux Toolkit com RTK Query, Zustand, Jotai, e separação clara entre estados de servidor e cliente.
  • Ferramentas Modernas: Webpack 5, Rollup, configuração avançada do Vite e uso de micro-frontends com Module Federation.
️ Backend com .NET
  • C# Avançado: Uso de pattern matching, records, tipos nulos (nullable reference types) e geradores de código (source generators).
  • Domínio do .NET 8: Trabalho com Minimal APIs, compilação com Native AOT, otimizações com System.Text.Json e hot reload.
  • Real-time com SignalR: Notificações em tempo real, chats, atualizações dinâmicas e estratégias de escalabilidade.
  • Serviços em Background: Processamento assíncrono com hosted services, filas, jobs agendados e desligamento gracioso.
  • gRPC: Comunicação eficiente entre serviços, streaming, balanceamento de carga e contratos binários.
  • Event Sourcing: Uso de event stores, projeções, sagas e consistência eventual.
️ DevOps & Infraestrutura
  • Kubernetes: Estratégias de deploy, escalabilidade horizontal, troubleshooting, monitoramento e uso de service mesh.
  • CI/CD: Criação de pipelines eficientes, integração com testes automatizados e deploys blue-green.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform (módulos reutilizáveis), CloudFormation e automação de ambientes.
  • Observabilidade: Implementação de APMs, tracing distribuído, métricas customizadas e alertas eficazes.
  • Arquitetura Cloud: Adoção das boas práticas do AWS Well-Architected Framework, otimização de custos e estratégias de recuperação de desastres.
  • Segurança em DevOps: Práticas de DevSecOps, varredura de vulnerabilidades e automação de conformidade.

  • Experiência com GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets
  • Event Streaming com Kafka, RabbitMQ ou Azure Service Bus
  • Conhecimento em Blazor, SignalR, Background Services

Job description

Somos um Grupoformado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes.Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando ofoco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos.

FOCO NAS PESSOAS

Nossosvalores

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Venha fazer história com a gente!

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.


Media Buying & Strategy
  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.
Campaign Execution & Management
  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.

  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
Budget Management
  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.
Skills & Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.

  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

  • Write articles and documents in order to increase personal and business profile.
  • Meet the requirements established for the performance of their function and, if necessary, expose them to a higher level.
  • Adherence to all relevant regulatory requirements forms part of your role, and the demonstration of behaviours as set out in the Conduct Risk Policy, as they relate to your role, is core to LSM's commitment to our Liberty Values, placing customers at the centre of our business and behaving with integrity. LSM expects you to understand your responsibilities relating to all regulatory and internal requirements, and to proactively demonstrate compliance with these requirements and behaviours at all times. These requirements include the Senior Managers and Certification Regime Conduct Rules ,Solvency II, fair treatment of customers, Financial Crime, Data Protection, Conflicts of Interest, and Whistleblowing.

Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher degree.

  • Great negotiation, analysis and decision-making skills are also required.

About Liberty Mutual Reinsurance

Liberty Mutual Reinsurance is part of Global Risk Solutions and the broader Liberty Mutual Insurance Group, which is a leading global insurer. We offer a breadth of world-class insurance and reinsurance services to brokers and insureds in all major markets.

Our people are key to our success. That is why “Put People First" is one of the five Liberty values which unite us as a global organisation. We bring this to life for our colleagues through:

  • Reinforcing that collaborating together to share our unique perspectives help us make better decisions, deliver innovative solutions and pursue our ambitious goals.

  • 5+ years of experience as a full-stack developer, building scalable, secure, and user-friendly web applications from inception to deployment.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Compras que será responsável pela condução estratégica e tática dos processos de aquisição de serviços e materiais.
Responsabilidades:
  • Desenvolver estratégias alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios.
  • Avaliar o custo-benefício e realizar análises financeiras.
  • Conduzir negociações focadas em preços e condições contratuais favoráveis.
  • Identificar e cultivar parcerias com fornecedores que agreguem valor.
  • Antecipar e mitigar riscos associados à aquisição de serviços e materiais.
  • Buscar oportunidades constantes para inovação e melhoria nos processos de aquisição.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com outras áreas para alinhar aquisições aos objetivos corporativos.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado e mudanças no setor.
  • Garantir conformidade com regulamentações internas e externas.
  • Comunicar efetivamente estratégias e decisões de aquisição para partes interessadas.
Requisitos:
  • Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia como comprador em processos de aquição de materiais e serviços industriais.
  • Utilização de SAP MM e Ariba Sourcing.
Diferencial:
  • Experiência em empresas de O&G.
  • Inglês Intermediário.
Oferecemos:
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo:
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
E tapas do Processo Seletivo:
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, garantindo o transporte seguro e sustentável de gás natural.
Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

description:
Descrição da vaga
Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados com experiência, que curta e busque todos os desafios que uma consultoria tem a oferecer: clientes, negócios e soluções diferentes a cada projeto.
É necessário conhecimento técnicos sobre a indústria de Óleo e Gás.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Principais Atividades

  • Montar modelos preditivos e de machine learning;
  • Soluções de analytics e BI também serão desenvolvidas para prover a melhor solução e experiência possível para o cliente, para que de fato as ações sejam tomadas;
  • Contato direto com equipe de consultoria de negócios a fim de entender o problema e possíveis soluções a serem desenvolvidas, aumentando nossa assertividade e impacto!
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de modelos com metodologias estatísticas distintas e linguagens de programação variadas. Lembre-se: aqui você poderá atuar de forma dinâmica, em diferentes desafios e negócios;

  • Suportar a equipe de consultores para encontrar soluções para os problemas de negócios com uso de dados;
  • Elaborar painéis em Power BI, rodar rotinas de atualizações de dados mensais, assegurar e propor melhorias na governança de dados;

Requisitos e qualificações
Formação
  • Superior completo, com especialização em ciência de dados;

  • Formação em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia do Petróleo será um diferencial.

HERE TO DARE

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.
Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA
Estamos em busca de um(a) CONSULTOR(A) DE VENDAS (HUNTER DE NEGÓCIOS E LEADS) com perfil dinâmico e comunicativo para prospectar e desenvolver uma carteira de empresas parceiras (no varejo e comércio em geral), com foco em captação de leads e vendas de serviços de internet banda larga e serviços agregados para residências. Atuar como ponto focal e realizar a positivação, treinar sobre uso de ferramentas de vendas e dar suporte aos lojistas parceiros.
Se você é movido(a) por conexão com pessoas e tem paixão por vendas, o Grupo Live One é o lugar ideal para você brilhar e crescer!
Somos uma empresa inclusiva! PCD’S são muito bem-vindos em nosso time.
#VemSerLiveOne!
O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Experiência comprovada com vendas diretas para empresas ou abertura de parcerias comerciais;
  • Profundo entendimento em técnicas de vendas e negociações (preferencialmente em produtos de Telefonia);
  • Domínio em ferramentas digitais como: programas, aplicativos, plataformas virtuais;
  • Desenvolver sua própria carteira de clientes e prospects;
  • Atuar com excelente comunicação, entusiasmo e criatividade;
  • Transformar oportunidades e desafios em conquistas;
  • Ser autogerenciável e ter habilidade com gestão de tarefas;
  • Realizar visitas de prospecção e atendimento a empresas em lugares alinhados com a gestão;
  • Ter disponibilidade para deslocamento em cidades vizinhas e interestaduais da região (se necessário);
  • Orientação para resultados e entrega de soluções;
  • Força de vontade e foco em ser destaque nos resultados;
  • Capacidade de seguir diretrizes e procedimentos padrão;
  • Disponibilidade para participar ativamente das reuniões e compromissos da organização, quando solicitado;
  • Executar demais atividades correlatas ao cargo, segundo necessidades da área e direcionamento da liderança;
  • Realizar a venda direta de todos os serviços disponibilizados pela empresa em ações externas aos escritórios;
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
  • Graduação em andamento em Administração, Marketing, ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano com vendas diretas e ou abertura de negócios com parceiros comerciais;
  • Residência próxima ao local de trabalho;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e mídias digitais;
  • Disponibilidade trabalhar em horário comercial;
  • Flexibilidade para realizar ações externas;
  • Carro próprio e CNH ativa (comprovação obrigatória);
  • Notebook próprio;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens interestaduais (quando necessário).
INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
  • No Grupo Live One você vai encontrar:
  • Cultura de trabalho que respeita e valoriza as pessoas;
  • Desenvolvimento de Carreira;
  • Plano de Cargos e Salários com possibilidades horizontais e verticais, ou seja, você é o protagonista de sua carreira!
  • Premiação SEM TETO sobre metas atingidas;
  • Convênio Saúde pela Unimed;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Convênio Farmácia e Wellhub/Gympass (para cuidar da saúde);
  • Descontos em Instituições de Ensino Superior de até 50%;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Ajuda de Custo Deslocamento e Reembolso para estacionamentos;
  • Day Off (folga de aniversário);
ETAPAS DO PROCESSO
  • Cadastro
  • Triagem
  • Testes ou Avaliações
  • Painel de Entrevistas
  • Treinamento (como etapa eliminatória)
  • Contratação
NOSSO JEITO DE SER?
Desde 2014, o Grupo Live One se destaca como uma empresa que valoriza o respeito pelas pessoas, parceria, inovação. Fundado em Campinas, interior de São Paulo, como parte de um grupo empresarial consolidado, crescemos rapidamente e contamos hoje com mais de 1000 colaboradores espalhados por mais de 10 estados do Brasil, que transformam desafios em conquistas todos os dias. Com orgulho de nossas realizações, recebemos, nos últimos dois anos, o selo internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW), reconhecendo nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e colaborativo. Esse sucesso é reflexo do esforço conjunto de pessoas que escolheram fazer parte do nosso time e da nossa cultura focada em resultados e inovação.
Na Live One, nossos valores são a base de tudo o que fazemos: Parceria que fortalece relações, Inovação que impulsiona o futuro, Respeito por cada indivíduo, Pessoas como o centro de nossas ações, Atitude para enfrentar desafios, Comprometimento com a excelência e Ética em cada decisão.

SOBRE A CAPCO
A CAPCO é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira! Se você mora em Vitoria - ES essa vaga é para você!
RESUMO DA FUNÇÃO
02 anos de experiência em atividades similares ao escopo dos serviços. Sendo 01 (um) ano de experiência offshore ou pós graduação em área correlata (nutricionista offshore)

  • Executar a fiscalização técnico-operacional Offshore dos contratos de hotelaria marítima e fornecimento de alimentação, visando garantir pleno atendimento dos requisitos previstos no contrato de prestação dos serviços e legislação sanitária vigente.
  • Inspecionar o recebimento e organizar o armazenamento e movimentação de insumos.
  • Verificar conformidade de processos.
  • Liberar produtos e serviços.
  • Trabalhar de acordo com normas e procedimentos técnicos, de qualidade e de segurança e demonstrar domínio de conhecimentos técnicos específicos da área.
  • Residir em RJ ou ES.
RESPONSABILIDADES
  • Atuar como apoio técnico, dentro do limite de sua competência, em auditorias, inspeções sanitárias, investigações relacionadas a acidentes/incidentes envolvendo a prestação dos serviços fiscalizados.
  • Preencher relatório diário de ocorrência e manter os sistemas de gestão contratual indicados.
  • Verificar cumprimento de notificação da fiscalização e monitorar atendimento de prazos concedidos.
  • Atender denúncias e reclamações, tramitando com os devidos encaminhamentos necessários conforme fluxo de comunicação definido.
  • Elaborar guias, procedimentos e padrões para melhorias da rotina operacional.
  • Ministrar treinamentos internos e promover alinhamentos, sempre queidentificada necessidade ou conforme demanda.
  • Coordenar equipes e avaliar desempenho de profissionais.
  • Apreender cautelarmente e/ou solicitar descarte ou devolução de alimentos ou produtos que possam oferecer risco a saúde ou estejam em desconformidade com a especificação contratual.
  • Realizar ações de educação nutricional e vigilância sanitária nas copas e restaurantes, em articulação com outros setores e participar da elaboração do material didático e/ou orientativo.
  • Elaborar relatório das atividades realizadas e reportar aos públicos de interesse.
  • Demais atividades correlatas, necessárias à execução dos serviços técnicos de fiscalização dos contratos de hotelaria marítima.
R EQUISITOS
  • Residir em Vitória.
  • Graduação em Nutrição.
  • Experiência Offshore OU Pós Graduação (Nutrição Offshore).
  • Fortes habilidades em comunicação e apresentação de resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.
POR QUE CAPCO?
Juntar-se à CAPCO significa ingressar em uma organização comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo onde você é incentivado a #BeYourselfAtWork (Ser Você Mesmo no Trabalho). Celebramos a individualidade e reconhecemos que a diversidade e a inclusão, em todas as formas, são fundamentais para o sucesso. Acreditamos que todos trazem algo diferente, por isso adoraríamos saber o que o torna diferente!

Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência! Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.
Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance! Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.
Sobre o Programa de Estágio MCS MARKUP
O Programa de Estágio MCS identifica, integra e desenvolve estagiários dispostos a construir um futuro profissional e uma carreira de sucesso.
Temos, no mínimo, 25 oportunidades disponíveis pelo Brasil , distribuídas entre diferentes áreas e localidades.
Em que áreas posso atuar?

  • Auditoria Externa - somente candidatos RJ e SP
  • Contábil - somente candidatos RJ, SP e ES
  • Departamento Pessoal – candidatos de todo Brasil
  • Financial Services - somente candidatos SP
  • Fiscal - somente candidatos RJ e SP
  • Direito Empresarial - somente candidatos RJ
  • Previdenciário - somente candidatos de RJ e SP
  • Transaction Services - somente candidatos de SP
O que eu preciso para participar?
  • Matrícula ativa a partir do 3º período de um curso superior de Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou a partir do 2º período em Tecnologia da Informação ou Tecnólogo em Recursos Humanos.
  • Ter disponibilidade para iniciar no dia 06/10/2025.
Quais são os benefícios do Programa de Estágio da MCS?
Bolsa auxílio;
Seguro de vida;
Vale refeição ou alimentação;
Vale transporte;
Wellhub (Gympass) e TotalPass;
Parcerias em Instituições de Ensino e Idiomas;
Plataforma de Gestão de Saúde Emocional;
Day off no seu aniversário;
Desenvolvimento e monitoramento profissional com trilha de carreira;
Universidade Corporativa.
Etapas do processo:
Inscrição: Inicie sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nossa equipe irá analisar as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
Dinâmica em grupo: A etapa de dinâmica em grupo é uma fase importante do processo seletivo pois nos permite avaliar suas habilidades interpessoais, trabalho em equipe e resolução de problemas em um ambiente interativo. Durante essa atividade, os candidatos são divididos em grupos e enfrentam desafios ou situações simuladas que exigem colaboração e comunicação.
Entrevista com Recursos Humanos: Você terá a oportunidade de dialogar com nosso time de Atração de Talentos; Seleção. O objetivo é nos conhecermos melhor e garantir que nossos valores e abordagens estejam alinhados com suas crenças e expectativas.
Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta fase, mergulharemos no seu conhecimento técnico para avaliar as habilidades e competências essenciais para a posição.
Retorno do processo: Independentemente do resultado, iremos comunicá-lo a você e discutir os próximos passos.

title: Community Associate
description:
Community Associate

RIO DE JANEIRO, Americas

The world of work is changing…short commutes, flexibility, and convenience are the minimum standards employees want when it comes to how they want to work!

At IWG, we are leading the way. We’ve built the world’s largest workspace network so that our customers can work from wherever, and however they want…in over 120 countries across the globe!

Join us and help us bring more freedom to people and businesses, while expanding our network. You’ll be able to enjoy a great work life balance and competitive benefits, while growing your career path along the way.

The opportunity

As a Community Associate, you’ll work closely with new and existing customers across a myriad of industries, working to create and maintain your own community within your center, where you will help take care of all the administrative and support needs for your customers…so that your customers can focus on running their business.

A typical day at IWG

You arrive a few minutes before your center opens to make sure everything is ready and check there’s nothing the cleaners have missed.

Customers arrive all throughout the morning. One asks you for a changed WiFi code. Another wants to know if his important package has arrived. A woman needs directions to her meeting room… and can you help her set up the projector and show her where to find a great cup of coffee. You’re off to help her get set-up, as soon as you connect the incoming call to another customer. You may sure that all of the services are properly charged, so that invoices are accurate.

It’s time for a quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

The mail arrives. You sort through it while dealing with a whole host of other customer requests, remembering to email the customer from earlier to let him know his package is waiting for him in his mailbox. And that’s lunch.

A new wave of customers arrive throughout the afternoon. You help a customer with printing and another with their invoice. A customer in a team room say it’s too hot in their office, no problem you are on it and open a ticket in our service portal.

You’ve earned yourself another quick coffee break, relax and enjoy a few minutes to yourself.

Early afternoon, you sit down with the Community Manager to discuss the organization of next week’s networking event in your center. You plan and write the e-invites to customers, then create, print and put-up posters on the noticeboards around the center. To your excitement, the Community Manager is coming around the corner with a prospect (someone interested in joining the IWG community), you share a few details about what makes this space so amazing for your customers and encourage them to join the network soon so they can participate in next week’s networking event – then you head back to finish putting up your posters.

The day is coming to a close. Time to gently ask the large group in meeting room 3 to start wrapping up. You direct them to the nice restaurant you know around the corner, so they can grab a bite and continue their discussion. You ensure everything’s nice and tidy, it’s time to head home.

About you

We’re looking for someone who knows how to manage multiple tasks while providing customers with the best possible service. You also need to be:

  • A good communicator, with the ability to build strong professional relationships and empathize with people’s needs (Ideally 1+ years of customer service experience)
  • Happy taking ownership of problems and finding ways to solve them
  • Positive, enthusiastic, and able to adapt to fast-changing situations
  • Experience and confidence using MS Office and other basic IT equipment
  • Legally eligible to work in the Country you are applying within and at least 18 years old
  • B1 or higher level of English communication skills

What we offer

On top of a competitive total compensation package, you’ll enjoy:

  • Work life balance(no standard nights/weekends)
  • Generous paid time off plans (sick and vacation)
  • Paid Company Holidays per calendar year (in addition to your PTO accrual)
  • A quarterly bonus plan program, with a competitive salary rate
  • A bright and inspiring work environment
  • Training and development opportunities aligned with great career path opportunities
  • A professional workplace community (business casual attire required)

title: MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (RETINA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ
description:
Join to apply for the MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (RETINA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Join to apply for the MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (RETINA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.
A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica, Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia, Registro de Qualificação de Especialidade (RQE);
Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;
Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Retina.
Informações adicionais
  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Associate Sales Operations Analyst
description:

11 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Associate Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Associate Sales Operations Analysts to support a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be collaborative and demonstrate initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be detail oriented problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales teams, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will support the delivery of programs to enable Canonical's continued success.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.
The role entails:

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Check opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Analysts and Manager to report on and improve sales data quality and processes
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Assist the team with automation and streamlining of the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you:
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience working in an entry-level role in sales operations or related (e.g. financial analysis, sales analysis or sales order processing), preferably in the technology industry
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and communicate effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. What we are looking for in you
  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Página da Vaga | ANALISTA DE CUSTO PLENO
description:
Job description

Somos um time que cuida da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade.

Entendemos que para obter os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais.

Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano.

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz, e é focado em resultados essa VAGA é para VOCÊ!


Main responsibilities

Diariamente você vai:

  • Elaboração e acompanhamento de orçamentos: Analisar e controlar os custos, elaborar projeções e acompanhar o realizado em relação ao orçado;
  • Análise e controle de custos: Monitorar os custos diretos e indiretos, identificar variações e propor ações para redução de gastos;
  • Cálculo e análise de custos de produtos e serviços: Determinar o custo de produção, avaliar a rentabilidade de produtos e serviços, e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Gestão de estoque: Analisar e controlar os estoques, visando otimizar os níveis de estoque e reduzir custos de armazenagem;
  • Cálculo de custos padrão e análise de desvios: Determinar os custos padrão para cada produto ou serviço e analisar os desvios em relação aos custos reais, identificando as causas e propondo ações corretivas.
  • Elaboração de relatórios e indicadores de custos: Gerar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho para acompanhamento e tomada de decisões;
  • Participação em projetos de redução de custos: Contribuir para projetos que visam a redução de custos e otimização de processos;
  • Suporte à área financeira e contábil: Fornecer informações sobre custos para a área financeira e contábil, auxiliando na elaboração de demonstrações contábeis e fiscais;
  • Análise de preços de venda: Avaliar a formação de preços, considerando os custos e a margem de lucro desejada.

Requirements and skills

Para você fazer parte do nosso Grupo de talentos, você precisa ter:

  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Finanças, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência de custos, formação de preços, análise de custos, orçamentos, estoques;
  • Experiência com planejamento financeiro, controle orçamentário, CAPEX/OPEX;
  • Experiência em modelagem financeira, análise de sensibilidade;
  • Desejável CRC ativo;
  • Experiência e conhecimento das melhores práticas de contabilidade (CPCs).

Sistemas e Ferramentas

  • ERP (ex: SAP, Protheus, Oracle, Sankhya entre outros);
  • Excel avançado (com VBA);
  • Power BI (como diferencial).

Additional information

Além de um ambiente desenvolvedor, oferecemos ao nosso time:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Day Off;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com faculdades;
  • Convênio com farmácias;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Descontos nos nossos produtos em nossa loja online.

WHS Coordinator will be responsible for partnering with a site operations team in FCs to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance with all applicable local and regional regulations. The WHS Coordinator will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risks in our processes, ensuring a safe and healthful working environment for associates inside operations.

You will instruct and train Operations Leaders in Amazon safety policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards. You will work to identify best practices and incorporate these into our standards to continuously improve the safety culture.

WHS Coordinator responsibilities:

  • Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance with all applicable local regulations and Amazon safety policies.
  • Measure site performance against published safety requirements. For deficiencies, identify and implement corrective plans.
  • Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
  • Implement continuous improvement and WHSMS projects.
  • Analyze safety metrics and review incident data regularly to identify trends and allocate resources to high-risk areas.
  • Perform site safety audits to identify non-compliance issues and implement solutions to eliminate risks and prevent injuries.
  • Audit record-keeping practices and safety database entries to ensure alignment with global standards and local regulations.
  • Audit workplace organization and associate behaviors to ensure training, auditing, and scoring are accurate and consistent.
  • Perform and report incident investigations.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Microsoft Office products.
  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends, nights, and holidays.
  • Technical course in Occupational Safety with registration at the Ministry of Labor and Employment (MTE).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • English language proficiency.

description:
Join to apply for the Insurance Manager role at FIFA Women's World Cup

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working alongside FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Application Deadline: 2 June 2025

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. The Insurance Manager will also serve as the local contact for Insurance Brokers.

All tasks should be conducted in close collaboration with the FIFA Insurance Lead, and where needed, with the FIFA Audit, Risk & Advisory subdivision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and monitor appropriate local insurance solutions (Personal, Property Damage, Business Interruption, Marine Cargo & Liability insurances) for all FWWC 2027 entities.

  • Collaborate with Legal and Procurement teams to ensure all contracts with sponsors, suppliers, and contractors include adequate insurance clauses, indemnities, and warranties.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor an insurance manual and claim administration policies for stakeholders.
  • Manage claims (Personal, Property, Liability), recording, administering, and reporting them, and coordinating with the FIFA Lead Insurance, brokers, and insurers.
  • Serve as the insurance interface for all internal and external stakeholders of FWWC 2027.
  • Identify and evaluate potential risks, proposing countermeasures.
  • Support the implementation of a local risk management program.
  • Organize regular insurance surveys.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in insurance and risk management.
  • Solid experience with the Brazilian insurance market and risk management, including contract drafting.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian insurance laws and standard practices.
  • Familiarity with local market players and negotiation experience.
  • Proven track record in risk management and insurance issue resolution, including understanding of deductible settings.
  • Right to work in Brazil.

description:
Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.
Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.
Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

  • Please submit resume in English**
The Company You’ll Join
At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.
We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.
At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.
To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.
The Problems You’ll Solve
As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.
  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers
The Impact You’ll Have
You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.
About You
From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.
  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software
Salary
Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). We are hiring for multiple levels and locations , so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors.

Descrição da vaga
A Origem Energia
Nosso propósito é contribuir para o desenvolvimento do Brasil por meio da integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente.
Aqui, energia não nos falta para buscar os melhores resultados, sempre com a segurança em primeiro lugar. Na Origem não existem problemas “dos outros”, trabalhamos unidos como um só time e somos eficientes em tudo que fazemos, evitando desperdícios. Entendemos que só assim continuaremos crescendo, gerando oportunidades para todos e contribuindo para uma transição segura da matriz energética brasileira rumo a uma economia de baixo carbono.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, conduzir e acompanhar programas de capacitação e trilhas de aprendizagem desde a fase de diagnóstico, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia e cultura organizacional da Cia, de modo a gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio.
  • Participar ativamente do ciclo de avaliação de desempenho em todas as suas etapas, desde o planejamento até o fechamento, participando de feedbacks e apoiando líderes e colaboradores na construção dos planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI).
  • Ministrar treinamentos, workshops e apresentações para públicos diversos, transmitindo conteúdos de forma engajadora.
  • Conduzir o programa de onboarding de novos colaboradores a fim de promover engajamento e o desempenho, atuando no mapeamento e produção de conteúdos com áreas parceiras.
  • Atuar no mapeamento e curadoria de conteúdos e fornecedores que contribuirão para a produção de conteúdos e experiências de aprendizagem.
  • Participar da construção de planos de comunicação eficazes para promover as iniciativas da área junto a áreas parceiras de forma engajadora.
  • Participar de iniciativas e projetos de cultura organizacional, pesquisas de engajamento, EVP (proposta de valor ao colaborador) e ações de endomarketing.
  • Atuar na execução e acompanhamento de programas de incentivo, como o programa de bolsas de estudos de pós-graduação e MBA.
  • Realizar análises de indicadores e dados da área, propondo planos de ação e melhorias.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação em Psicologia, Administração, Pedagogia ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência com educação corporativa e avaliação de desempenho;
  • Desejável conhecimento em 6Ds e design instrucional;
  • Domínio do pacote Office, especialmente Excel e apresentações em PowerPoint. Outras ferramentas de criação de conteúdo (como Canva, Articulate, etc.) serão diferenciais;
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação para se relacionar com diferentes áreas e níveis;
  • Senso crítico, organização e atenção a detalhes para lidar com grande volume de dados e informações;
  • Criatividade para propor soluções e contribuir com novas ideias;
  • Adaptabilidade, protagonismo e curiosidade;
  • Orientação para resultados e resolução de problemas;
Informações adicionais
Regime e horário: administrativo - de segunda à sexta das 9h às 18h.
Benefícios oferecidos:
  • Assistência médica para o titular e seus dependentes;
  • Assistência odontológica para o titular e seus dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação - aqui, o(a) colaborador(a) escolhe como prefere dividir o valor em cada modalidade!
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa de remuneração variável (PLR);
VEM SER ORIGEM!
Estamos entre as principais companhias independentes com atuação no Onshore do Brasil. Nosso maior diferencial é produzir energia por meio do gás natural, recurso energético mais estável e limpo. Com isso, participamos ativamente da expansão e da transformação da matriz de energia brasileira rumo à economia de baixo carbono.
Somos movidos pelo propósito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento do país mediante a integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente. Priorizamos a execução de estratégias e projetos responsáveis para promover um desenvolvimento mais homogêneo das regiões onde atuamos .
Nossa origem é feminina , com diferentes nacionalidades e culturas. Temos o compromisso com a diversidade e a pluralidade. Nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória cheia de energia com audácia, empreendedorismo, inovação e busca por oportunidades. Juntos, vamos apoiar na transição segura da matriz energética brasileira.
O time Origem conta com a sua energia.

description:
Join to apply for the ENFERMEIRO DIARISTA - CENTRO CIRÚRGICO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

Since December 2015, SPDM/PAIS has been responsible, in partnership with the Municipal Health Department of Rio de Janeiro, for managing the Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

The hospital infrastructure includes ten floors with emergency services and adult, pediatric, and neonatal Intensive Care Units (ICU); maternity; medical, general surgery, bucomaxillofacial, neurosurgery, psychiatry, pediatrics, and orthopedics clinics. Imaging exams (X-ray, CT, ultrasound, ECG, echocardiography) and laboratory tests are also performed.

Due to the large elderly population in the West Zone served by the hospital, there are two wards dedicated to this demographic.

The Burn Treatment Center is another feature, offering an exclusive ICU to prevent infections that can be severe for burn patients.

The unit also includes the Regional Emergency Coordination (CER) Santa Cruz, with 39 beds, aimed at handling less complex cases, freeing the HMPII for urgent surgery, high-risk cases, and hospitalization. A notable feature of this CER is the specialized care in Psychiatry and Obstetrics.

Responsibilities and duties

Promote, together with the immediate supervisor, a work environment that fosters continuous improvements in the care process, coordinating with other areas to ensure the institution's objectives are met and users receive quality care.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Complete higher education in Nursing
  • Full specialization in Urgency/Emergency (Emergency Room), Public Health, Health Management, or Multiprofessional Health Residency
  • Active registration with the professional council
  • Minimum of 6 months experience as a Nurse

Additional information

  • Location: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Work schedule: Monday to Friday (40h)
  • Working hours: 08:00 to 17:00

Partners, suppliers, or service providers, or those with familial or affinity ties within the same service, or working under different contractual modalities, should consult current HR policies with the Recruitment and Selection department.

title: South Region QEHS Manager
description:
Join to apply for the South Region QEHS Manager role at Wärtsilä

Join to apply for the South Region QEHS Manager role at Wärtsilä

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Wärtsiläis a global leaderininnovativetechnologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. We emphasize innovation in sustainable technology and services to help our customers continuously improve their environmental and economic performance. Energy leads the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. We help our partners to accelerate their decarbonization journeys through our market-leading technologies and power system modelling expertise. These cover decarbonization services, future-fuel enabled balancing power plants, hybrid solutions, energy storage and optimization technology, including the GEMS Digital Energy Platform.
Did you know Wärtsilä has delivered 79 GW of power plant capacity and more than 130 energy storage installations in 180 countries around the world?
In this fast-changing world of energy, we are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Want to join the ride?
We are looking for a QEHS Manager for our Region South which includes the following countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay and Uruguay . This role leads the development and execution of health, safety, and environmental strategies to ensure compliance with regulations and promote a culture of safety and sustainability across the organization.
The role is responsible for implementing the Wärtsilä QEHS strategies, policies and programs and ensuring organizational excellence in HSEQ compliance and performance. You will be entrusted with the development of Regional Action plans and the advancement of strategic endeavors that contribute to a culture of safety, the reduction of work-related risks, and the maintenance of compliance with established safety, health, and environmental standards at every Wärtsilä site and operational sphere.
The role has 2 direct reports across multiple countries. The position will be located in one of the main locations of the Region (with a preference for location in Brazil) and report to the Americas QEHSS Director.
Key Accountabilities

  • Provides HSE oversight and support across diverse activities, including, not limited to workshops, power plants, service projects, construction sites, and office environments.
  • Leads Health, Safety & Environment activities, ensuring compliance with all local, regional, and international QEHS regulations, as well as company HSE standards
  • Strengthen safety culture by establishing, executing and reinforcing policies, procedures, behaviors, and initiatives.
  • Utilizing strong networking and influencing skills, build clear communication channels representing QEHS across all South Regional sites to a complex set of stakeholders, including the Regional Management, local and global QEHS teams.
  • Support global initiatives with local priorities and applicability, translating and implementing global HSE strategies into relevant and actionable regional plans
  • Monitors Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Performance Metrics, reporting on trends and developing action plans for performance improvement. Drives continuous improvement in Health, Safety, Environment & Quality management.
  • Collaborates with leadership and cross-functional teams to integrate Health, Safety & Environment considerations into business operations and project planning. Engages with external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, to represent the company's Health, Safety & Environment interests and maintain positive relationships
  • Manages Health, Safety, Environment & Quality compliance, mitigating risks and overseeing adherence to all regulations and standards. Proactively updates practices based on changing regulations and ensures all products and services conform to technical specifications and standards.
  • Lead safety walkthroughs, audits, and site inspections in collaboration with operational teams
  • Spearhead regional risk assessment activities for the South Region, incorporating the identification of hazards, monitoring safety practices, and conducting job safety evaluations.
  • Leads incident investigations, ensuring thorough root cause analysis and ensures appropriate response and reporting procedures are followed.
  • Oversee regular QEHS audits and inspections across regional sites, tracking performance and implementing improvements.
Key Subject Matter Expertise
  • Environmental and Safety Regulations and principles in region
  • Customer Experience Management (CRM) Tools
  • Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001,14001,45001)
  • Quality Development (RCA, Investigation, Inspection, Supplier Development, etc.)
  • Analytical Skills (data analysis, trending, predictive analytics, AI)
  • Security (Physical Security, Travel Security, Crisis Management, Executive Protection)
  • Continuous Improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, 5S, etc.)
  • Business Acumen. Connecting QEHS Strategy with Business Key Priorities
  • People Leadership and Development
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., CSP, NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor) are significantly favored.
  • Strong experience in HSE management, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of local and international HSE regulations and standards.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to influence and drive changes.
  • Understanding different management systems and what is needed from a business perspective
  • Excellent communication skills, fluency in written and spoken English. Trilingual (Portuguese and Spanish) preferred.
Last application date: 28/07/2025
At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.
Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.
This is Wärtsilä
Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on July 2025, Wartsila Brazil will implement a new hybrid work model. Most employees who live within 65 kilometres of an office will work 6 days per month in office. This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. We will be happy to provide more information during your interview process.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Cloud Systems Architect - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 240 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. Today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About The Job

This role combines hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, focusing on delivering key indicators responsible for user happiness and efficient business operation. You will own a cost-efficient, highly scalable, high-availability system responsible for hosting and running tens of thousands of jobs simultaneously. You are expected to be a product-focused engineer, ready to radically improve the product in an always-changing environment.

We're looking for candidates who can design and build cloud systems, not just operate or maintain them.

About The Team

The Scrapy Cloud team comprises developers, data engineers, and product managers focused on building a high-performance, scalable platform. We prioritize practical engineering and collaboration, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Requirements

The more items you check from the following list, the better the chance we are looking for each other:

  • Experience in designing and executing experiments, including load testing, performance testing, and evaluating hardware components with basic statistical analysis.
  • Understanding of modern RDBMS architecture, concepts, and troubleshooting strategies.
  • Proficiency in Java or Python, or both.
  • Ability to fix broken builds in cross-language applications, and experience with integrating CPython with C libraries and Java.
  • Knowledge of HBase and Mesos is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Linux internals, including namespaces, containerization, process management, and memory management.
  • Ability to benchmark and integrate commodity server hardware via cloud and bare metal providers.
  • Good presentation and mentoring skills.

We are seeking candidates who can design and build cloud systems, rather than just operate or maintain them. The role is suited for those with experience beyond managing Kubernetes/OpenShift, and who have worked with load testing, hardware profiling, or program benchmarking. Candidates should have expertise beyond high-level web frameworks like Spring Boot, Django, Jersey, or Vert.x, and experience developing cloud solutions rather than only working as solution architects.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

  • Join a self-motivated, progressive, multicultural team.
  • Enjoy the flexibility to work from your preferred location.
  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools.
  • Receive 35 days of paid holidays.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • The Process Safety Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and coordinating process safety programs to ensure the safety and integrity of operations.
  • You analyze process hazards, evaluating safety systems, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. You play a crucial role in preventing accidents, minimizing risks, and promoting a strong safety culture within the organization.

Responsibilities

  • You support the SBM Operations or projects in the implementation of SBM Offshore’s Hazards and Effects Management Process and Operational Risk Management.
  • You provide guidance on best practices for lifecycle hazard management, including methodologies for Bowtie, PHA, HAZOP, HAZID, Inherently Safer Design, and barrier-based risk management.
  • You facilitate risk assessments and manage action tracking for assessments within the Process Safety Scope.
  • You support Safety and Environmentally Critical Element audits and assurance by technical teams from the group and/or operations.
  • You support audits and inspections conducted by regulatory agencies, verifiers, or clients.

Education

  • Bachelors degree in chemical engineering, process engineering, or similar.

Experience

  • Experience in process safety, technical safety, or other technical risk discipline (such as SLP Engineer).

Functional Competencies

Hazards and Effects Management - Hazards and Effects Management - Hazard Management Monitoring performance and compliance Process Analysis and Design Learning from events Incident Management Safety and Environment Engineering Safety Management Internal Audit Delivery Hazards and Effects Management - Formal Safety Assesment
